payout_quote: Once your friend completes the program requirements, you will BOTH receive a $50 Visa Reward Card!
steps: Be an Old National Bank client; enroll in the ReferLive referral program (online form, ReferLive app, phone 1-844-213-3046, or in a banking center)
Refer friends/family for a new eligible Old National checking account (not available to anyone who already has or jointly owns an ONB checking account)
Within 60 days of account opening, friend completes: 10 debit card purchases (ATM withdrawals excluded) AND direct deposits totaling $500+
You receive a $50 Visa Reward Card by mail within 4-6 weeks; friend gets one too
catches: Cap: up to 10 $50 Visa Reward Cards per calendar year ($500)
Friend must be new to ONB checking (cannot already have or jointly own one)
Requirements within 60 days per the ReferLive program page (an ONB FAQ page states 75 days — program page controls)
Reward is a mailed Visa Reward Card, not cash; allow 4-6 weeks for delivery
Each Reward Card amount may be reported as income to the IRS, state, and local tax authorities
biggest_catch: You each get a $50 Visa card — but your friend must do 10 debit purchases plus $500 in direct deposits within 60 days, and the reward comes by mail.
eligibility: Old National Bank clients; referred friends/family must be new-to-ONB checking customers
timing: Friend qualifies within 60 days of account opening; reward card mailed within 4-6 weeks

when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Friend qualifies within 60 days of account opening; reward card mailed within 4-6 weeks — structural: the reward is fulfilled as a mailed physical card (4-6 weeks) — no electronic payout option per terms.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The reward arrives as a physical card by mail (4-6 weeks); no expedite option exists in the terms — factor mail time into expectations.
Volume constraint noted in terms: Cap: up to 10 $50 Visa Reward Cards per calendar year ($500)', 'Friend must be new — plan referral count against the cap, not the calendar.
